en: Rectangular gallery announcement card with minimalist typography. It advertises an exhibition at Barbara Krakow Gallery, listing featured artists Alex Katz, Sarah Morris, and Ed Ruscha, along with additional artists under a 'Print Publisher's Spotlight / Solo Impression' heading. Dates of the exhibition and the gallery's contact information, address in Boston, Massachusetts, phone, fax, email, and website appear. Large vertical and horizontal text spells out 'BARBARA KRAKOW GALLERY.' Background is plain light color, no photograph or illustration.
